parameters.query:
SELECT c AS conta FROM nucleo.correio_para_ler($1, $2) c
WHERE nucleo.aprendiz_pode_rodar()   -- passou do teto de gasto do dia: pausa
SELECT nucleo.correio_guardar($1, nullif($2, '')::int, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, nullif($5, '')::jsonb, $6) AS r

SELECT CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN 0 ELSE nucleo.correio_aprendido(nullif($1, '')::int, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb,
         nullif($5, '')::int, nullif($6, '')::int, $7) END AS salvos,
  CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN nucleo.registrar_evento($9, 'aviso', 'Nao consegui aprender com o e-mail: ' || nucleo.motivo_erro($8), $8, '{}') END AS evento
SELECT nucleo.rodada_registrar($1::jsonb) AS rodadas, $2::int AS lidos, $3::int AS itens, $4::int AS contas
